implementationContract.readStateRule: Client HUD renders server snapshots and responses only; it does not mint currency, XP, ownership, job completion or travel state.
implementationContract.spendRule: No panel opening, card selection or preview action may debit currency. Spend requires a distinct user confirmation and server-owned validation.
implementationContract.idempotencyRule: Every durable purchase/reward/action uses one stable request identity per logical attempt; safe retry reuses that identity and duplicate completion is side-effect free.
implementationContract.restorationRule: Close, back, denial, respawn and completed action return to compact free-roam HUD without duplicating panels or listeners.
implementationContract.timingRule: Do not derive animation, movement or response timing from the clips because visible 2x playback is present.
